create_Mnist_dataset: create a Mnist dataset instance with custom train and eval batch sizes
build_train_dataset: build a training dataset iterator from the Mnist class with shuffling and prefetching
build_eval_datasets: build evaluation dataset iterators from the Mnist class for model testing
run_preprocess_batch: run the preprocess_batch function to normalize MNIST images using standard or identity mode
review_Split_enum: review the Split enum to get TRAIN and TEST example counts for MNIST
